The governance of the [[databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark|Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark]] (AFDK) encompasses its organizational anchoring, methodological oversight, and data reporting protocols. Structurally, the AFDK registry is formally anchored within the [[dansk-cardiologisk-selskab|Dansk Cardiologisk Selskab]] (DCS), ensuring that its clinical and administrative operations align with national cardiological standards [^src2]. 

Methodological governance is driven by the [[afdk-styregruppe|Styregruppen for AFDK]], which continuously evaluates how data is processed and presented. Recognizing shifts in the patient population, the steering group has actively considered age-standardizing all result indicators to account for demographic developments and ensure equitable performance comparisons across different regions and hospitals [^src1]. 

In addition to methodological oversight, governance strictly enforces data privacy and publication rules in alignment with the [[sundhedsvaesenets-kvalitetsinstitut|Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut]]. To prevent the identification of individuals in small cohorts, any published results in the report's tables that rely on only 1 or 2 patient pathways in the numerator or denominator are systematically replaced with a "#" symbol prior to public release [^src3].

## Claims

- Styregruppen overvejer at alders-standardisere alle resultatindikatorer på grund af den demografisk udvikling [^src1] (afdk-styregruppe)
  Type: governance
  Page: 66
  Source: wikis/rkkp-afdk/raw/AFDK_2023.pdf, pages 66-70
- AFDK er forankret i Dansk Cardiologisk Selskab (DCS) [^src2] (databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark, dansk-cardiologisk-selskab)
  Type: governance
  Page: 67
  Source: wikis/rkkp-afdk/raw/AFDK_2024.pdf, pages 66-70
- Resultater med 1 eller 2 patientforløb i tæller eller nævner er erstattet med # i rapportens tabeller ved offentliggørelse [^src1] (sundhedsvaesenets-kvalitetsinstitut)
  Type: governance
  Page: 5
  Source: wikis/rkkp-afdk/raw/AFDK_2025.pdf, pages 1-5
